stem: Environmental factors typically activate genes in a cell by causing the cell to —

options.label: A
options.text: produce identical daughter cells through mitosis

options.label: B
options.text: form haploid gamete cells through meiosis

options.label: C
options.text: fuse with another cell to increase the size of its genome

options.label: D
options.text: transcribe specific DNA segments to mRNA for translation
